outcome: Persistent pulmonary hypertension of the newborn (PPHN)
cohort: Newborns admitted to a neonatal unit between 2006 and 2018 due to fetomaternal hemorrhage (>=30 mL fetal blood transfused into the maternal circulation).
finding: More than one-third of neonates with anemia due to fetomaternal hemorrhage (FMH) experienced persistent pulmonary hypertension of the newborn (PPHN) and severe brain injury, with antenatal intrauterine transfusion (IUT) appearing to reduce these risks.
